programme.title: Traffic Safety With Poli
programme.desc: Cerita Berpusat Pada Kevin Dan Doug, Dua Anak Kecil Di Kota Broomstown Yang Sering Bermain Ceroboh Dan Melanggar Aturan Lalu Lintas, Seperti Menyeberang Sembarangan Atau Mengejar Bola Ke Jalan Raya. programme.title: Boboiboy

programme.title: Amazing Syafaat
programme.desc: Amazing Syafaat adalah program religi yang menampilkan kisah nyata perjalanan hidup dari kesalahan menuju taubat, disertai pesan moral dan pencerahan tentang iman serta harapan akan syafaat.

programme.title: Misteri Hidup
programme.desc: Misteri Hidup adalah program yang mengupas berbagai misteri kehidupan, mulai dari sejarah, asal-usul, hingga teori konspirasi, dengan penyajian yang mudah dipahami dan berbasis fakta. Program ini mengajak pemirsa memahami makna hidup serta menanamkan nilai-nilai luhur untuk saling menghormati.

programme.title: Kabarnya Viral
programme.desc: Program entertainment news magazine yang menghadirkan kompilasi tentang berbagai macam informasi dan topik yang terbaik & terunik versi KABARNYA VIRAL.

programme.title: Orang Baik
programme.desc: ORANG BAIK adalah program inspiratif yang mengangkat kisah nyata tentang perjuangan, kepedulian, dan aksi nyata tentang kebaikan dari berbagai lapisan masyarakat. Setiap episode menghadirkan sosok-sosok luar biasa yang tanpa pamrih memberikan bantuan dan dukungan bagi sesama, baik melalui aksi sosial, pemberdayaan, maupun pengorbanan pribadi. Program ini tidak hanya menampilkan cerita menyentuh, tetapi juga mengajak pemirsa untuk terinspirasi dan ikut serta dalam gerakan kebaikan, memperlihatkan bahwa kebaikan ada di sekitar dan dapat dilakukan oleh siapa saja.

programme.title: Kampung Geulis
programme.desc: Kampung Geulis Serial ini mengisahkan kehidupan sehari-hari yang penuh komedi di sebuah kampung, menampilkan karakter-karakter unik dengan nuansa budaya Sunda. Sitkom ini sering menampilkan kisah menarik warga

programme.title: Serambi Islami
programme.desc: Program kajian islam unggulan yang berformat talkshow menghadirkan narasumber atau pakar agama serta tokoh masyarakat

programme.title: MASHA AND THE BEAR
programme.desc: Seekor beruang sirkus pensiunan menetap di hutan dan bersiap untuk kehidupan baru yang tenang dikelilingi oleh kedamaian dan ketenangan sampai dia diperkenalkan dengan seorang gadis kecil petualang bernama Masha. Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.title: LITTLE ANGEL SEASON 2
programme.desc: Bernyanyilah bersama Bayi John dan keluarganya dengan lagu anak-anak klasik dan lagu-lagu baru yang menarik yang membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari semua tentang dunia

programme.title: Tayo In Real Life
programme.desc: Apa yang akan terjadi hari ini? Mari kita lihat keseharian bus kecil Tayo dan teman-temannya.

programme.desc: Apa kau bosan? Apa yang harus kita lakukan hari ini? Ayo bermain bersama Pororo dan teman-temannya!

programme.title: Tayo's Quiz & Show
programme.desc: Belajar bahasa Inggris dengan Tayo menggunakan berbagai suara di sekitar kita!

programme.title: TAYO
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan hidup bahagia bersama, bus kecil Tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak lagi yang harus dipelajari untuk Tayo. Tayo dan teman-temannya yang ramah, Rogi, Lani, dan Gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: Pororo's Thematic Show
programme.desc: Tema cerita Pororo dan kawan-kawan. Anda akan diajak ke desa Porong Porong, sebuah tempat yang penuh dengan petualangan.

programme.title: Pororo Season 7
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Pororo's Healthy Habits
programme.desc: Halo teman-teman? Saya Pororo! Bisakah kita belajar bersama tentang bagaimana tumbuh sebagai anak yang sehat?

programme.title: Harry's Character Battle
programme.desc: Pororo dan Tayo adalah teman yang sangat berbeda, tapi terkadang mereka sangat mirip karena mereka tidak pernah diam! Ada banyak kesamaan lainnya, jadi Harry melakukan analisis perbandingan lengkap tentang kedua sahabatnya ini! Mari kita mulai sekarang!

programme.title: The Ipswich Way : PL Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season. As a new chapter begins with Gary O'Neil following the successful reign of Kieran McKenna, we explore how the spirit, identity and ambition of Ipswich Town continues to shape its future.

programme.title: The Tigers Return : PL Stories
programme.desc: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief.? We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead, as they aim not just to survive in the Premier League, but to establish themselves there for years to come.

programme.title: Coventry Rising : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Malaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.? Alongside the preparations for the future, we reflect on the remarkable journey that has brought the Sky Blues back to the Premier League. From unforgettable highs to painful setbacks, financial turmoil to remarkable resurgence, we explore the defining moments that have shaped one of English football's most resilient clubs.

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: All Time Man City With Yaya Toure : 1-To-11
programme.desc: Premier League stars select their dream teams from the best they played with or against, guiding us through their picks with stories from on and off the pitch.

programme.title: Review
programme.desc: A comprehensive recap of each match week, delivered within hours of the final fixture of the round.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. From how the title was won, the fight for European spots, and the battle to avoid relegation - all the key moments are covered from another scintillating season.

programme.title: The Great North London Divide : PL Stories
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. We trace the origins of a feud shaped by geography, identity and decades of defining moments. We interweave the story of this season, which has reshaped the balance of power in North London and brings a fresh perspective to a rivalry already steeped in history. Through iconic matches and unforgettable characters, we capture what this rivalry has meant; and what it could become, as the two clubs look ahead to an uncertain future that may yet see them competing in very different circumstances.

programme.title: Pochettino'S Spurs : PL Stories
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Cup, we revisit the rise of current USA manager Mauricio Pochettino's unforgettable Tottenham Hotspur side; the team that transformed Spurs from top-four hopefuls into genuine challengers at home and in Europe. Playing fearless, high-intensity football and built around a young core of stars, Pochettino's Spurs came within touching distance of Premier League and Champions League glory, creating some of the club's greatest modern nights along the way. Through exclusive interviews with Pochettino and the key players who drove that era, we tell the story of a team that changed expectations forever and ask how something so promising ultimately fell apart.

programme.title: The Big Interview
programme.desc: Extended sit-downs and more informal 'out and about' interview with the Premier League's biggest stars, providing players with a platform to tell their story in their own words.

programme.title: Patrick Vieira : The Big Interview
programme.desc: From street football in Senegal to becoming Arsenal captain, Patrick Vieira reflects on the journey that shaped one of the league's most iconic figures, as he tells Steve Bower about the proudest chapter of his career: the 2003-04 Invincibles season.

programme.title: Ep05 : The Catch-Up Show
programme.desc: The Catch-Up Show is your chance to relive the 'best bits' from across the Premier League week with a compilation of all PLP content and programming.

programme.title: Kai Havertz : The Big Interview
programme.desc: As a young boy cheering from the terraces of his hometown club, Alemannia Aachen, Kai Havertz fell in love with a striker by the name of Erik Meijer. In this Extended version of the first Masterclass of the new season, Havertz' footballing icon surprises him at training, before the two share tricks of the trade on the art of forward play, recreating some of the Arsenal striker's best goals.

programme.title: Mw05 : Netbusters
programme.desc: A fast-paced music and commentary driven ISO angle highlights show featuring every game and every goal from each match round.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Haaland) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.desc: Some of the Premier League's biggest stars take us onto the pitch to discuss the techniques and thought processes that allow them to perform at the highest level. Featuring Brentford goalkeepers, Viktor Gyokeres, Callum Hudson-Odoi and Lucas Bergvall.

programme.title: Remembering Kevin Keegan : PL Moments
programme.desc: A celebration of Kevin Keegan's unforgettable contribution to the Premier League. Les Ferdinand and Shay Given revisit ten defining moments from his managerial career, combining iconic archive with personal memories of one of English football's most charismatic figures.

programme.title: Kevin Keegan : PL Stories
programme.desc: From fearless forward to one of English football's most inspirational figures, this is the story of Kevin Keegan. We chart his remarkable playing career with Liverpool, Hamburg and England before exploring his impact as a manager, where he inspired Newcastle United to become one of the Premier League's most captivating teams. Through triumphs, setbacks and an unwavering passion for the game, we celebrate the life and legacy of a true football icon.

programme.title: Les Ferdinand: Newcastle Run In 95/96 : Rewind
programme.desc: Still the only team in Premier League history to throw away a 12-point lead, Les Ferdinand tells the story of Newcastle's agonising? Run-In, where Kevin Keegan's side were pipped to the title by Manchester United.

programme.title: Denis Irwin: My Premier League Years : Rewind
programme.desc: Denis Irwin won 7 Premier League titles in his time at Manchester United. Named by Sir Alex Ferguson as "the one certainty to get in the team", Irwin reflects on key games from his outstanding career, including a trip to Old Trafford as an opposition player to face a young Cristiano Ronaldo.

programme.desc: From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption?stories. Now in love with the game again at Sunderland, Xhaka's story proves that perseverance can define a legacy as much as success

programme.title: The Big Interview
programme.desc: Extended sit-downs and more informal 'out and about' interview with the Premier League's biggest stars, providing players with a platform to tell their story in their own words.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. From how the title was won, the fight for European spots, and the battle to avoid relegation - all the key moments are covered from another scintillating season.

programme.title: (Subbed) Diogo Jota : PL Stories
programme.desc: One year on from the tragic death of Diogo Jota and his brother Andre in a car accident, this deeply emotional PL Stories show celebrates the life of one of football's most loved figures. Through interviews with friends, teammates and coaches from Portugal to the Premier League, we look back on Jota's journey, the impact he had on those around him, and the legacy he left behind both on and off the pitch.

programme.title: Ep04 : PL Masterclass
programme.desc: Some of the Premier League's biggest stars take us onto the pitch to discuss the techniques and thought processes that allow them to perform at the highest level. Featuring Brentford goalkeepers, Viktor Gyokeres, Callum Hudson-Odoi and Lucas Bergvall.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Haaland) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: The Great North London Divide : PL Stories
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. We trace the origins of a feud shaped by geography, identity and decades of defining moments. We interweave the story of this season, which has reshaped the balance of power in North London and brings a fresh perspective to a rivalry already steeped in history. Through iconic matches and unforgettable characters, we capture what this rivalry has meant; and what it could become, as the two clubs look ahead to an uncertain future that may yet see them competing in very different circumstances.

programme.title: Pochettino'S Spurs : PL Stories
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Cup, we revisit the rise of current USA manager Mauricio Pochettino's unforgettable Tottenham Hotspur side; the team that transformed Spurs from top-four hopefuls into genuine challengers at home and in Europe. Playing fearless, high-intensity football and built around a young core of stars, Pochettino's Spurs came within touching distance of Premier League and Champions League glory, creating some of the club's greatest modern nights along the way. Through exclusive interviews with Pochettino and the key players who drove that era, we tell the story of a team that changed expectations forever and ask how something so promising ultimately fell apart.

programme.title: Kai Havertz : The Big Interview
programme.desc: As a young boy cheering from the terraces of his hometown club, Alemannia Aachen, Kai Havertz fell in love with a striker by the name of Erik Meijer. In this Extended version of the first Masterclass of the new season, Havertz' footballing icon surprises him at training, before the two share tricks of the trade on the art of forward play, recreating some of the Arsenal striker's best goals.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season

programme.title: Patrick Vieira : The Big Interview
programme.desc: From street football in Senegal to becoming Arsenal captain, Patrick Vieira reflects on the journey that shaped one of the league's most iconic figures, as he tells Steve Bower about the proudest chapter of his career: the 2003-04 Invincibles season.

programme.title: Peter & Kasper Schmeichel : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Sharing 6 Premier League trophies between them, Peter and Kasper Schmeichel can be classed individually amongst the best goalkeepers of the Premier League era. This week, the Big Interview takes the rare opportunity of having father and son together. The pair discuss their fascinating dynamic, a relationship that developed from Kasper's formative years growing up around a father who won 5 Premier League titles in a dominant Manchester United side. The pair then share incredible insight around the evolution of the art of goalkeeping, spanning their own careers to the present day.

programme.title: Goalkeeping With Petr Cech : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Legendary goalkeeper, Petr Cech, sits down with Will Perry to discuss the role of the goalkeeper in the Premier League and how it has changed over the years. Cech gives his unique insight into the mentality of a goalkeeper and reflects on his career before breaking down and analysing some of the key attributes that make a great goalkeeper. He also selects five iconic Premier League goalkeepers to build his dream keeper for the modern game.

programme.title: Petr Cech : PL Stories
programme.desc: One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Cech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programme.title: Gianfranco Zola: My Chelsea Years : Rewind
programme.desc: Gianfranco Zola signed for Chelsea in November 1996, aged 30. The Little Magician became a trailblazer as one of the Premier League's first genuine flair players, and by the time of his departure seven seasons later, he had established himself as an all-time great at Stamford Bridge.

programme.title: Gary Cahill: My Chelsea Years : Rewind
programme.desc: A tale of two seasons - Gary Cahill recalls the Chelsea championship campaigns of 2014/15 under Jose Mourinho, and 2016/17 with Antonio Conte at the helm.
